title: Merged deployment checklist
description: orchestrator/runs/<client>/<run-id>/deployment-checklist.yaml — one merged checklist, generated only after verify-coverage succeeds. Reuses frontend's own deployment-checklist.yaml items verbatim (source: 'frontend-track'); backend has no structured deployment-item extraction today, so a single explicit pointer item (source: 'backend-track-manual-review') directs the developer to backend's own report/state.json rather than fabricating structured items that don't exist.
